title: Adopt replacement storage for retained operational work
actor: A maintainer adopting a replacement record store
goal: Preserve current work and required history through a supported storage migration.
context: Existing operational records contain active work, retained evidence and potentially unsupported historical formats.
trigger: The maintainer requests migration of an explicit source scope.
preconditions: The actor explicitly identifies the project and intended scope.
Any requested mutation is subject to applicable project authority.

interaction.action: Selects source scope and replacement destination.
Reports supported import, archival-only content, source identities and unresolved dependencies.
Supplies any required disposition and requests the authorized migration.
Reports one coherent imported scope with provenance, or a blocked/interrupted outcome that preserves sources.

expected_outcome: Current work remains retrievable through one authoritative destination, with required originals recoverable and source dispositions explicit.

alternatives.condition: Some completed historical records are unsupported for import.
alternatives.outcome: They remain attributable archival evidence after current dependencies are resolved; they acquire no runtime support.

failures.condition: An unsupported record is still needed by active work.
failures.outcome: Activation remains blocked pending an explicit responsible disposition.

failures.condition: Source content changes, destination conflicts or migration is interrupted.
failures.outcome: The system preserves original and unrelated work, reports the actual outcome and never activates a partial import as complete.

sources.basis: Draft derivation from the refined IRs and RR proposal; no approval, implementation or satisfaction claim.
